coordinator.scope: ONLY this Python scheduling parent; no native benchmark, browser, GPU, or other process signaled.

phone.ownershipSource: Observed exact owned native and all /proc descendants while its Python scheduling parent was stopped. New follower continues discovering descendants until natural exit.

desktop.ownershipSource: Observed exact owned native and all /proc descendants while its Python scheduling parent was stopped. New follower continues discovering descendants until natural exit.

note: R9 in-flight native attempts finish naturally. R10 must wait for each profile native and every observed surviving descendant before starting that profile. All prior negative results and raw partial cases stay unchanged.
